case.firstInstance: Juzgado de Primera Instancia nº 4 de Arrecife — JV 1260/2011 — Sentencia 122/2012, 7-May-2012
case.appeal: Audiencia Provincial de Las Palmas, Sección Cuarta — Rollo 793/2012 — Sentencia 89/2014, 13-Jan-2014
case.method: Separate documented fact, investigative inference, adverse/counter-evidence and unresolved criminal element.

findings.labelEs: Las cinco sociedades demandantes estaban presentes o representadas en la constitución de CEXP del 29-abr-2008
findings.labelEn: All five corporate claimants were present or represented at the 29-Apr-2008 CEXP-formation meeting
findings.limit: The recovered ACTA does not yet identify the 10.01% non-participating vote unit by unit.

findings.labelEs: Álvaro Campanario integró representación de los futuros demandantes y gobierno comunitario antes de JV1260
findings.labelEn: Álvaro Campanario combined future-claimant representation with Community-governance participation before JV1260
findings.detail: 2-Feb-2011 ACTA places him as representative of most of the future claimant perimeter, meeting Secretary and proponent of procedural strategy; he later acted as plaintiffs' lawyer in JV1260 and on appeal.

findings.labelEs: El ACTA de 22-jun-2011 documenta un filtro deuda → derecho de voto → decisión
findings.labelEn: The 22-Jun-2011 ACTA documents a debt → voting-right → decision filter
findings.detail: LPB's large represented coefficient is outside the separate voting-right list, while a claimant-linked minority perimeter appears inside it.
findings.limit: Legal validity of the debts and exclusions requires separate adjudication/reconstruction.

findings.labelEs: La demanda de 23-dic-2011 alegó toma de llaves 'manu militari' desde julio de 2008
findings.labelEn: The 23-Dec-2011 claim alleged a 'manu militari' taking of keys from July 2008
findings.investigativeQuestion: Whether that origin account materially omitted the formal April/May-2008 collective CEXP transition and each claimant unit's participation status.

findings.labelEs: Los propios demandantes ampliaron el 23-feb-2012 contra Monterecco por un cambio de explotación
findings.labelEn: The claimants themselves expanded the case against Monterecco on 23-Feb-2012 after an alleged change of operation

findings.labelEs: El allanamiento de CEXP fue cualificado: no admitió la afirmación de que explotaba los 18 apartamentos
findings.labelEn: CEXP's submission was qualified: it did not admit the allegation that it exploited the 18 apartments
findings.counterEvidence: Contemporaneous incoming-side records indicate return of owners' possession/maintenance keys was itself being considered voluntarily.

findings.labelEs: La primera instancia no encontró prueba suficiente de posesión/explotación de Monterecco
findings.labelEn: First instance found insufficient proof of Monterecco possession/operation of the claimant units

findings.labelEs: La AP utilizó un hecho probatorio posterior a la sentencia —la entrega de llaves de 28-may-2012— para inferir posesión de Monterecco
findings.labelEn: The AP used a post-judgment evidential event —the 28-May-2012 key delivery— in inferring Monterecco possession
findings.investigativeQuestion: Contemporaneous sheets call the keys maintenance copies; full notarial act and appellate filing remain P1 before attributing mischaracterisation.

findings.labelEs: En 18-may-2018 la única línea listada con derecho a voto estaba vinculada a AMENEM/Shaila (0,385%), con CAM/Laura y LPB/Borja presentes/representados
findings.labelEn: On 18-May-2018 the only line listed with voting rights was AMENEM/Shaila-linked (0.385%), while CAM/Laura and LPB/Borja were present/represented
findings.detail: The meeting then approved Community security/access control unanimously by those listed with voting rights.

findings.labelEs: Finca 8718, distinta de las 18 litigadas, pasó del perímetro Tengolf/Amenem a CAM por escrituras de 23 y 31-may-2018
findings.labelEn: Finca 8718, separate from the 18 litigated units, passed from the Tengolf/Amenem perimeter to CAM by deeds dated 23 and 31-May-2018
findings.limit: No present evidence establishes that the conveyances were consideration for a vote or part of a 2011 agreement.

actorAccountability.finding: Integrated claimant representation, Community governance and litigation role is documented.
actorAccountability.notEstablished: Knowing falsehood, intent, evidence manipulation or criminal agreement.
Role in characterising the 28-May evidence until actual appellate filings are recovered.

actorAccountability.finding: Real owner grievances coexist with integrated governance/litigation activity and potentially incomplete origin framing.

actorAccountability.actor: Construcciones Acosta Matos / Laura Acosta Matos
actorAccountability.finding: Documented presence in 18-May-2018 governance/security node and subsequent title acquisition in Finca 8718.
actorAccountability.notEstablished: Direction or participation in 2011 JV1260 litigation.

criminalProceduralGrade.rule: Do not promote to criminal conclusion without actor-specific knowledge, deceptive conduct, causal judicial error and prejudice.

p1KeystoneEvidence: complete 28-May-2012 notarial act (AP f.718 et seq.)
2008 unit-level accession/non-accession schedule for all 18 units
complete detective report and Community certificate used in original claim
knowledge evidence concerning maintenance-key character when new evidence was filed
communications linking 18-May security vote, acquisitions and 7-Jun event
